2026-04-01 / simulation bench notes
- StandardWater topology runs all the way past 2500 s.
- WaterNaCl still gets ugly when a pump transition becomes active. Do NOT delete pump states.
- Tiny solver steps around port-level crossing disappeared with hysteresis.
- Q_up fix stopped B5 boil/no-boil switching.
- Old notebook says B7 20 C; CR-017 says 25 C.
- Physical K1 exists; combined B5/K1 is only a simulation abstraction.
- P&ID shows more valves than the StateGraph. Determine ownership before generating controller ports.
